source_name: MNB — Pénzforgalmi intézmények adatszolgáltatás (reporting obligations page)
why_relevant: Sets out what payment institutions must report to the MNB and on what forms/frequency. Reveals which datasets exist upstream (even when only aggregates are published) and therefore what can be requested or expected to appear in supervisory statistics — critical for planning data acquisition on POS/acquiring volumes.

source_name: MNB Statisztika – Pénzforgalmi archív tartalmak (2001-2013 archive)
why_relevant: Historic HU payment series discontinued in the current release: chip-migration data, card business-line statistics, card-fraud cases, interbank system turnover 2002-2010. Essential for long-run POS/ATM and card penetration back-series.

source_name: MNB — Közvetítők keresése (intermediaries register)
why_relevant: Register of money-market and insurance intermediaries/agents. Payment-service distribution partners and agent networks (including cash-in/cash-out and POS distribution agents) surface here rather than in the main institution register.

source_name: MNB — Hungarian cross-border service providers register
why_relevant: Lists Hungarian payment/e-money institutions passporting services abroad — reveals which HU payment actors are regionally expansive (relevant when sizing HU-headquartered PSPs vs. inbound EEA players).

source_name: NAV közérdekű adatok / adatbázisok (tax authority public-data and database hub)
why_relevant: Entry point to NAV's statutory publication lists and datasets; the route to levy-revenue and filing-aggregate data and to formal FOI (közérdekű adatigénylés) requests for payment-levy breakdowns not published proactively.

source_name: opendata.gov.hu – igényelhető közadatok kereső
why_relevant: Catalogue of requestable public datasets organised by governmental function; the formal route to request non-published HU financial/payment datasets and to see which bodies hold them.

source_name: NAV public-data disclosure list – registers maintained by NAV (nyilvántartások)
why_relevant: The statutory inventory of every register NAV keeps — the cheapest way to discover which payment/cash-register datasets exist at all, including ones never published, and therefore what can be requested under freedom-of-information rules.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség - Tagjaink (member institutions list)
why_relevant: Fetched page lists roughly 67 full and associate member institutions - OTP, MBH, K&H, Erste, CIB, Raiffeisen, UniCredit, foreign branches (Deutsche Bank, BNP Paribas, ING, Citibank Europe), mortgage banks, savings institutions, plus payment/market infrastructure members KELER and BISZ. This is the master actor map for the whole HU institutional landscape.

source_name: FinTechZone — Elektronikus fizetési megoldások kézikönyve
why_relevant: A standing handbook/directory of electronic payment solutions available in Hungary. Functions as an actor map: PSPs, acquirers, wallet and instant-payment providers with descriptions — an efficient way to snowball into vendor-level primary sources for the HU payments market.

entity_name: TED / EU public procurement notices for Hungarian bank-card acceptance and POS services
source_name: TED CPV vocabulary reference (Common Procurement Vocabulary)
why_relevant: Authoritative CPV code list needed to build the deterministic query set for ATM (cash dispensers), payment terminals, card production/personalisation, security/cash-in-transit and financial-IT services in both TED and the Hungarian database (which also supports obsolete codes).

source_name: Arcanum Digitheca – Magyar Közlöny 1945–2019 digital archive
why_relevant: Full-text searchable historical gazette archive for reconstructing the long-run legislative history of cash, levy and payment rules beyond what the current portal exposes.

source_name: bankkartya.hu — sajtószemle / kártyagyártók (card-industry press digest)
why_relevant: Hungarian card-industry news digest with a dedicated 'kártyagyártók' (card manufacturers) category — a local-language pointer into the HU card supplier ecosystem and bank-supplier relationships.

entity_name: Nemzeti Cégtár / OPTEN company registry data
source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár / céginformációs szolgáltatók – GIRO Zrt. cégadatok és pénzügyi mutatók
why_relevant: Company-register-derived financial data on the operator (revenue, equity, ownership by the MNB/banks) — a cross-check on the operator's own annual accounts and a proxy for clearing-fee revenue trends. Statutory filings are also obtainable from e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu.

source_name: Wikipédia (hu) – Azonnali Fizetési Rendszer és GIRO rendszer szócikkek
why_relevant: Cheap entity/alias map and citation trail for AFR, GIRO, BKR, InterGIRO1/2, GIROInstant — useful for snowballing to primary sources and for resolving naming variants, but never citable as evidence itself.

source_name: Wikipédia (hu) entries for Magyar Bankszövetség and Országos Kereskedelmi Szövetség
why_relevant: Low-credibility but high-yield orientation layer: gives founding dates (Bankszövetség registered Feb 1989; OKSZ founded 23 Apr 1990), officeholders, alias names and outbound links used to seed further searches. Never cite as evidence; use for glossary and entity resolution only.

source_name: 10times.com — Hungary business/finance event calendar (incl. International Payment Forum, Budapest)
why_relevant: Aggregator that catches smaller or vendor-run Budapest payments events not covered by Portfolio or Fintechzone (e.g. an International Payment Forum listing). Useful purely as a discovery net for new event brands; details must be verified on the organiser's own site.

source_name: Cardnet Zrt. (POS terminal service, cash registers, loyalty/gift cards)
why_relevant: Long-standing Hungarian POS terminal service / cash-register and card-personalisation company; relevant as a terminal-estate service actor. Only a LinkedIn company page was confirmed in search — its own corporate domain was not established in this pass, so the LinkedIn profile is the confirmed pointer.

source_name: data.europa.eu – Hungary country page and HU dataset harvest
why_relevant: The EU aggregator harvests Hungarian national portal metadata; its records often survive after the national portal reorganises, giving a recoverable dataset identifier and description for HU financial datasets.

source_name: DataPortals.org – opendata-hu entry
why_relevant: Long-standing portal directory that preserves descriptions and URLs of Hungarian open-data portals, including defunct ones — useful for reconstructing where HU datasets used to live.

source_name: Dateno registry – Hungary data catalogs index
why_relevant: Third-party registry enumerating Hungarian data catalogues (including the National Public Data Portal) with catalogue-level metadata — a fast way to snowball into HU portals that do not rank in ordinary search.

source_name: Hiventures — Hungarian state venture capital fund manager
why_relevant: Largest HU state VC; reported in 2026 to have launched a HUF 17bn early-stage programme with tickets up to EUR 300k. Its portfolio and announcement pages are the most systematic public list of funded Hungarian fintech/payment startups, i.e. the future competitive set.

source_name: Hungaricana Közgyűjteményi Portál
why_relevant: Aggregates NKA-funded library/archive/museum digitisation (operated by the Parliamentary Library, built by Arcanum); a pointer to digitised official gazettes and institutional yearbooks that contain historical banking/payment ordinances and statistics.

source_name: HWSW.hu – e-commerce/research archive
why_relevant: Long-running Hungarian tech outlet with a deep archive of eNET and GKI Digital survey coverage going back a decade; the practical way to recover historic payment-method-split figures whose original press releases are no longer online.

source_name: Közadatkereső (kozadat.hu) – public-data metadata search
why_relevant: Statutory metadata search operated under the NISZ Közadat programme; indexes document type, creation date and web address of published public-interest data from thousands of Hungarian bodies — useful for locating URLs of publications that have since disappeared from publisher sites.

source_name: Laurel Számítástechnikai Kft. — Referenciák (client reference page)
why_relevant: Hungarian financial-sector software house with an explicit customer-reference page; Laurel is also reported as co-developer with Raiffeisen Bank on an MNB-supported electronic payment solution. Reference lists are the classic indirect route to private-bank supplier relationships.

source_name: Magyar Franchise Szövetség (Hungarian Franchise Association)
why_relevant: Founded 1991 as the interest body of the franchise business community; its member list maps multi-site retail and hospitality networks that are POS/acceptance customers - a useful secondary merchant-side actor map.

source_name: Nemzeti Közadatportál (National Public Data Portal)
why_relevant: Official public-data cadastre listing registers and databases held by Hungarian state bodies; used to discover that a payment/banking dataset exists at MNB, KSH, NAV or a ministry even when no public download page does.

source_name: OpenData.hu – civil Hungarian open-data catalogue
why_relevant: NGO/volunteer-built CKAN-style catalogue that has historically hosted scraped copies of Hungarian public datasets, including ones later withdrawn by the original publisher.

source_name: PosNavigator.eu – HU POS provider comparison portal
why_relevant: Comparison portal enumerating HU POS terminal providers with pricing and feature matrices — a shortcut to a near-complete actor list of terminal operators serving HU merchants, including smaller players not visible in scheme communications.

source_name: SecuriFocus – Pénzszállítás cégadatbázis (security-industry company directory)
why_relevant: Sector directory listing HU cash-transport companies — a cheap snowballing source to enumerate smaller regional CIT operators not visible in national press.

source_name: TenderHelp Hungary – EKR/TED guidance and tender interface explainer
why_relevant: Practitioner-oriented explainer of the Hungarian tendering interfaces (EKR, TED, KEF, DKÜ) — useful for correctly modelling which portal carries which class of notice, and for glossary/terminology building.
